mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(o.order_count, 0) AS order_count, COALESCE(o.sales_amount, 0) AS sales_amount, COALESCE(c.cancel_count, 0) AS cancel_count, COALESCE(c.cancel_amount, 0) AS cancel_amount FROM ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(p.amount) AS sales_amount FROM payment p WHERE p.status IN ('DONE', 'CANCELED') AND p.approved_at >= #{saleDate} AND p.approved_at < #{saleDate} + INTERVAL 1 DAY ) o, ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS cancel_count, SUM(p.amount) AS cancel_amount FROM payment p WHERE p.status = 'CANCELED' AND p.canceled_at >= #{saleDate} AND p.canceled_at < #{saleDate} + INTERVAL 1 DAY ) c

SELECT oi.product_id, SUM(oi.quantity) AS sold_quantity, SUM(oi.price_snapshot * oi.quantity) AS sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS order_count FROM order_item oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN payment p ON p.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status IN ('PAID', 'PREPARING', 'SHIPPED', 'DELIVERED') AND p.approved_at >= #{saleDate} AND p.approved_at < #{saleDate} + INTERVAL 1 DAY GROUP BY oi.product_id ORDER BY oi.product_id ASC
